thread:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: P1 Alert — increased probe failures for eu-central-1 (service: eu-probes). Alert id: PD-87921. Please acknowledge if you are oncall.

alex.k: ack — I'm oncall and looking.

maria_s: seeing a spike in 5xxs on the hosted API dashboards + synthetic probes showing failures. probe_success metric shows `NaN`/no datapoints since 10:02Z.

sachin: collector logs show a flood of `400 Bad Request` from probe-agent starting ~10:02Z, then telemetry stops at 10:05Z. Investigating ingestion path.

devon: from a few jump hosts in eu-central-1, DNS lookups for service endpoints are intermittently failing — `dig` returns SERVFAIL sometimes.

infra-bot: Deploy log: deployment `infra/monitoring` at 10:00Z updated `probes-config.yml` (change set id: cs-8842).

alex.k: @maria_s can you check that deploy? if probe targets got mis-templated that could explain both the failures and the missing telemetry.

maria_s: looked at PR #4132 — suspect templating bug. used `${region_code}` var which isn't populated; valid var is `${region}`. roll back in progress.

sachin: confirming: ingestion buffer spiked after malformed probe payloads, backpressure dropped metric writes. increasing buffer + triggering backfill.

devon: muting noisy alerts for eu-probes while we fix the config (to avoid wake-ups).

infra-bot: Action: mute eu-probes notifications for 30m (muted by devon).

maria_s: rolling back `probes-config.yml` to commit `a9c3b2f` now.

maria_s: rollback commands:
```
git checkout a9c3b2f -- monitoring/probes-config.yml
git commit -m "revert: probe target templating regression"
git push && deploy infra/monitoring
```

sachin: re-ingest/backfill started. metrics are returning for region tag `eu-central-1`. ingestion logs show resumed writes at 10:12Z.

alex.k: quick customer impact summary: between 10:02–10:08Z we saw ~5.6% error rate spike for requests routed to eu-central-1; global impact ~1.8% increase. No data loss, some retries and slightly higher latencies as traffic fell back to other regions.

emily: posting a status update: "Partial telemetry/probe outage affecting eu-central-1; some customers may see increased errors or latency. Investigating." Will update status.redwood.com now.

maria_s: local healthcheck after rollback:
```
curl -sS https://eu-central-1-probe.internal/health | jq .
{"status":"ok","probe_version":"2026-02-11","uptime":"00:04:12"}
```

devon: traffic fallback rules engaged for tiered routing — non-critical traffic shifted to eu-west-1 automatically. observed small latency bump but no session terminations. :thumbsup:

sachin: backfill complete at 10:18Z, dashboards patched. adding a synthetic self-check to alert if probe metrics are missing for >2m.

alex.k: handoff: handing oncall to @maria_s for post-incident monitoring and RCA follow-up. Handoff time 10:30Z.

maria_s: taking over. created internal ticket INC-2026-342 (assigned: monitoring + infra). Action items: 1) add templating unit test for probe config, 2) add deploy guard for monitoring changes, 3) add synthetic telemetry self-check + alert, 4) postmortem doc + timeline. ETA for RCA doc: EOD.

emily: I'll update the public status once RCA draft exists and close the incident note when confirmed resolved.

alex.k: confirmed resolved for now — probes stable, metrics flowing, customer-facing errors subsided. closing oncall for active paging. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged and resolved by alex.k.

(threads notes: follow-up ticket and RCA required; avoid re-rolling monitor changes without canary and templating checks)
